verdict.rationale: Convex is a backend platform with public HTTP APIs and client libraries, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no versioned API scheme and no deprecation policy. The CLI's pushing of 'new versions' of functions to a dev deployment is code deployment, not API versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
